s: We also believe that we will maintain our position as a market leader by applying Big Data and Augmented Reality & Artificial Intelligence (“AR/AI”) technology to both our planned and future AtoN projects, such as our Integrated Maritime Weather Signal Control & Monitoring System project (2016 – 2017).

In 2015 and 2016, we developed a number of products and solutions, including the S-100-based ECDIS, Maritime Augmented Reality, the Collision Avoidance System, the Ship Motion Monitoring System, the Voyage Optimization System, the AI-based Remote Maintenance System and Ship’s Data Platform.
